entities.summary: Feng Zhenghu is a Chinese economist and scholar based in Shanghai. Citing Amnesty International, The Guardian said that Feng was "a prominent human rights defender" in mainland China. In 2001 he was sent to prison for three years ostensibly for "illegal business activity". He was released in 2004 and has since written critical pieces highlighting alleged malpractice by local governments and forced evictions. Feng Zhenghu was a performers & entertainers from Wenzhou (b. 1954-07-01, Wenzhou). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
